# Diagnostic reference

Every problem MarkUP reports has a stable code. Tools can filter on codes; messages may improve between versions.

Severities are the defaults; a few diagnostics use a different severity in specific situations (for example, chart length mismatches are warnings).

## Syntax

| Code | Name | Severity | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `MU1001` | unclosed-directive | error | A container directive was never closed with a `:::` fence. |
| `MU1002` | implicitly-closed-directive | error | A container directive was closed implicitly by the closing fence of an outer directive or by the end of its parent block. |
| `MU1003` | stray-closing-fence | error | A closing fence does not match any open container directive at this nesting level. |
| `MU1004` | short-closing-fence | error | A closing fence is shorter than the opening fence of the innermost open directive. |
| `MU1005` | directive-trailing-content | error | Unexpected text after a block directive’s name, label or attributes. |
| `MU1006` | directive-name-spacing | warning | Whitespace between the colons and a directive name (`::: note`). The directive is still recognised; write `:::note`. |
| `MU1007` | unterminated-label | error | A directive label `[` is not closed on the same line. |
| `MU1008` | unterminated-attributes | error | An attribute block `{` is not closed. |
| `MU1009` | invalid-attribute | error | An attribute block contains something that is not an id, class or key/value pair. |
| `MU1010` | duplicate-attribute | warning | The same attribute key appears more than once; the last value wins. |
| `MU1011` | unclosed-code-fence | warning | A fenced code block runs to the end of its container without a closing fence. |
| `MU1012` | comment-problem | warning | A `<!--` comment block is never closed with `-->`, or has text after `-->` that is hidden with it. |
| `MU1013` | missing-directive-name | error | A directive fence is not followed by a name. |
| `MU1014` | table-extra-cells | warning | A table row has more cells than the header; the extra cells are dropped. |
| `MU1015` | nesting-too-deep | error | Nesting exceeds the parser’s depth limit; deeper structure is flattened into text. |
| `MU1016` | unclosed-front-matter | warning | A front matter block opened with `---` on the first line is never closed. |

## MarkUP Data

| Code | Name | Severity | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `MU1501` | data-syntax | error | MarkUP Data (front matter or a data body) is malformed. |
| `MU1502` | data-duplicate-key | error | A key appears twice in the same MarkUP Data mapping; the later entry is ignored. |
| `MU1503` | data-tab-indent | error | MarkUP Data indentation must use spaces, not tabs. |
| `MU1504` | data-unterminated-string | error | A quoted string in MarkUP Data is not closed on its line. |

## Validation

| Code | Name | Severity | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `MU2001` | unknown-directive | warning | No component with this name is registered. |
| `MU2002` | directive-form-not-allowed | error | The component cannot be used in this form (inline, leaf or container). |
| `MU2003` | unknown-attribute | warning | The component does not declare this attribute. |
| `MU2004` | invalid-attribute-value | error | An attribute value does not match the component’s schema. |
| `MU2005` | missing-attribute | error | A required attribute is missing. |
| `MU2006` | missing-label | error | The component requires a `[label]`. |
| `MU2007` | unexpected-label | warning | The component does not use a `[label]`; it is ignored. |
| `MU2008` | invalid-parent | error | The component is placed inside a parent that does not allow it. |
| `MU2009` | invalid-child | error | The component only accepts specific children. |
| `MU2010` | invalid-data | error | A data body or front matter value does not match its schema. |
| `MU2011` | missing-body | error | The component requires a body. |
| `MU2020` | duplicate-id | warning | Two elements share the same id. |
| `MU2021` | undefined-footnote | warning | A footnote reference has no matching definition. |
| `MU2022` | unused-footnote | hint | A footnote definition is never referenced. |
| `MU2023` | unsafe-url | warning | A link or image URL uses a scheme that renderers refuse to output. |
| `MU2024` | duplicate-definition | warning | A link reference or footnote label is defined more than once; the first definition wins. |
| `MU2025` | unresolved-anchor | warning | A `#fragment` link does not match any heading or id in the document. |

## Internal

| Code | Name | Severity | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `MU9001` | internal-error | error | The parser hit an internal error. Please report it. |
